quest.title: The Many Matters of the Moonchase Festival
quest.description: Linyang of the Liyue Adventurers' Guild seems to have something to say to you...

dialogues.speaker: Linyang
dialogues.text: Hmm... I need to place another batch of treasure chests, don't I...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did I hear someone mention treasure chests?

dialogues.speaker: Linyang
dialogues.text: Eh!? Oh, it's... it's you, Traveler! Are you here to take part in the Moonchase Festival as well?

dialogues.speaker: Linyang
dialogues.text: Then you've come at the right time! The Adventurers' Guild is currently organizing an event to celebrate the festival.

dialogues.speaker: Linyang
dialogues.text: Would you like to know more?

choices.text: What activities are we talking about here?

response.speaker: Linyang
response.text: During the Moonchase Festival, the Guild has placed Moonchase Charms in various places.

response.speaker: Linyang
response.text: Those who find these Charms can bring them back to us in exchange for various rewards.

response.speaker: Linyang
response.text: We've also dispatched a group of adventurers to place a large batch of special treasure chests out in the wild.

response.speaker: Linyang
response.text: These special treasure chests will come filled with all manner of goodies, which we've prepared just for this occasion!

response.speaker: Linyang
response.text: Other than these two activities, we've also got some tough challenges lined up for elite adventurers!

response.speaker: Linyang
response.text: As for the details, it's... Well, it involves invading a series of monster camps...

choices.text: And what does that have to do with the festival?

response.speaker: Linyang
response.text: Aha... Ahaha... I mean, uh, you don't have to put it like that...

response.speaker: Linyang
response.text: There's prizes to be had for beating those monsters!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's not all that different from normal commissions, come on...

response.speaker: Linyang
response.text: ...Please, just help us out! Most of our adventurers have left to go enjoy the festival, and many of our commissions are just sitting there with no one to take them up.

response.speaker: Linyang
response.text: Just lend us a hand! With your skills, it'll be a breeze, won't it?

response.speaker: Linyang
response.text: O—Of course, you'll be compensated fairly, Traveler, don't worry!

response.speaker: Linyang
response.text: I'll be here throughout the Moonchase Festival. If you have any questions, just ask me directly.

response.speaker: Linyang
response.text: We're counting on you, Traveler. Well then... enjoy the festival!

choices.text: That's got nothing to do with the Moonchase Festival at all!
Oh no, not the dailies again. Anything but that...

response.speaker: Linyang
response.text: No, no! This activity is super adventurer-like!
